explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. `multiplicativeGroupHomUnits` is the library's own equivalence, defined in the same file. It sends morphisms over `Spec K` into the multiplicative group scheme to units of global sections. The theorem says this equivalence preserves multiplication. The proof only uses the library's own private lemma `multiplicativeGroupHomUnits_symm_mul` (the inverse map preserves multiplication) together with `Equiv.symm_apply_apply` and injectivity. The mathematical content therefore lies in the library's definitions, not in any Mathlib result. The general fact that a bijection whose inverse preserves multiplication also preserves it is structural, so it does not count. Mathlib has no multiplicative group scheme object with this Hom-to-units equivalence that could match.
